cost_provenance: B22B MEASURED full quoted spread p50=3bp on this liquidity band -> 1.5bp half-spread, plus a 3.5bp impact rung (STRESS_LADDER).
known_bias: t17 universe comes from a CURRENT broker asset list: delisted names absent (survivorship). All formulas are dollar-neutral and XS-demeaned, which absorbs most of it.

null.method: time-shifted returns (>=5 days, both signs), one shared shift per draw so cross-config correlation is preserved

results.name: P2_ovn_gap_reversal
results.formula_desc: the stock's own overnight gap minus its beta-implied share of SPY's gap, faded from open to close (idiosyncratic overnight overreaction)

results.name: P3_ovn_gap_momentum
results.formula_desc: the SAME idiosyncratic overnight gap traded with the opposite sign (continuation instead of reversal)

results.name: L4_spy_gap_k20
results.formula_desc: same catch-up gap over SPY's last 20 days (slow transmission)

results.name: M2_sector_gap_k5
results.formula_desc: same sector-ETF catch-up gap over the last 5 days

results.name: O10_xasset_composite
results.formula_desc: sum of the TLT, UUP, USO, credit and VIXY one-day transmission signals (composite cross-asset push)

results.name: O1_rates_lead_TLT
results.formula_desc: yesterday's TLT (long-bond) return times each stock's trailing rate beta, XS-demeaned

results.name: O8_overseas_lead
results.formula_desc: yesterday's EFA+EWJ+FXI overseas-session basket return times each stock's EFA beta -- the foreign close leads the US open

results.name: L3_spy_gap_k5
results.formula_desc: same catch-up gap measured over SPY's last 5 days

results.name: O6_gold_lead_GLD
results.formula_desc: yesterday's GLD return times each stock's trailing gold beta

results.name: L7_spy_push_beta_xs
results.formula_desc: SPY's return yesterday times the stock's beta, XS-demeaned -- pure index transmission with NO own-return term

results.name: P4_overseas_leads_oc
results.formula_desc: the overseas basket's close-to-close move yesterday, times EFA beta, traded US open-to-close today

results.name: M3_sector_push_only
results.formula_desc: the most-loaded sector SPDR's own return yesterday, XS-demeaned -- sector transmission without the own-return term

results.name: M1_sector_gap_k1
results.formula_desc: each stock's catch-up gap against the sector SPDR it loads most on (1-day lead)

results.name: Q1_breadth_leads_spy
results.formula_desc: trade SPY ALONE on yesterday's gap between the equal-weight liquid universe and SPY itself (components lead the index)

results.name: P5_btcovn_leads_oc
results.formula_desc: Bitcoin's most recent completed UTC-day move (crypto trades while the US is shut) times BTC beta, held US open-to-close

results.name: N1_liqtier_lead
results.formula_desc: the top-liquidity-quintile basket's move yesterday leads the bottom-half-liquidity names' catch-up gap

results.name: L2_spy_gap_k2
results.formula_desc: same catch-up gap measured over SPY's last 2 days

results.name: O2_usd_lead_UUP
results.formula_desc: yesterday's UUP (dollar index) return times each stock's trailing dollar beta

results.name: O7_btc_lead_equity
results.formula_desc: yesterday's Bitcoin (Bitstamp spot) return times each stock's trailing BTC beta -- crypto-to-equity transmission

results.name: O4_credit_lead_HYGLQD
results.formula_desc: yesterday's HYG-minus-LQD credit-spread return times each stock's loading on it

results.name: P1_spyovn_leads_oc
results.formula_desc: SPY's OVERNIGHT gap times each stock's overnight beta, held from today's open to today's close

results.name: N2_size_rotation
results.formula_desc: yesterday's IWM-minus-SPY small-vs-large rotation times each name's loading on that spread

results.name: Q3_credit_leads_spy
results.formula_desc: trade SPY alone on yesterday's HYG-minus-LQD credit-spread move (credit leads equity)

results.name: L1_spy_gap_k1
results.formula_desc: each stock is long by how far SPY's beta-implied move yesterday exceeded the stock's own move (index-leads-component catch-up, XS-neutral)

results.name: L6_spy_gap_FADE
results.formula_desc: SIGN-FLIPPED SPY catch-up gap: names that already overshot SPY keep going

results.name: Q2_smh_leads_spy
results.formula_desc: trade SPY alone on yesterday's SMH-minus-SPY gap (semis as the cyclical bellwether leading the tape)

results.name: L5_spy_gap_rank
results.formula_desc: cross-sectional RANK of the 1-day SPY catch-up gap

results.name: L8_qqq_gap_k1
results.formula_desc: same 1-day catch-up gap but with QQQ as the leading index instead of SPY

results.name: O3_oil_lead_USO
results.formula_desc: yesterday's USO (crude) return times each stock's trailing oil beta

results.name: O9_rates_lead_5d
results.formula_desc: TLT's last 5 days times the stock's rate beta (slower rates transmission)

results.name: O5_vol_lead_VIXY
results.formula_desc: yesterday's VIXY return times each stock's trailing vol beta
